name: Virgin Snow ~Yuki Furu Oka de Anata to~
original_name: Virgin SNOW　～雪降る丘であなたと～
source:
There is a legend in this private school that couples giving promises at an old chapel are watched over by the snow spirits and live happily forever.
This story begins when main character receives an anonymous conservative love letter not far from graduation. Is it just a prank or real love confession. He has three weeks before St. Valentine's Day to find out.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这所私立学校流传着一个传说：在古老礼拜堂许下誓言的情侣会得到雪之精灵守护，从此永远幸福地生活在一起。

临近毕业时，主人公收到了一封匿名而措辞含蓄的情书，故事就此开始。那只是一场恶作剧，还是真心的告白？距离情人节还有三周，他必须在此前找出答案。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
